main_text.p: calidus : hacque ratione erit omnia, calidum, humidum, frigidum & ficcum : Sed quia 4. qualitates in vna eademque repræpollere non possunt, neque æstati neque hiemi vt compa- rare æquum est, sed potius ipsum per se æsti- mare. Neque enim hiems ipsa ea de causa fri- gida dicitur & humida, quod reliquis tempo- ribus humidior sit, frigidiorque, sed quod hu- miditas in ea superet siccitatem, & frigiditas calorem: ad eundem modum & æstas calida & ficca, quod in ea humor vincitur à ficco, & frigidum à calido. Sic & autumnus non recte frigidus dicitur & siccus, absolute, non enim frigidus est, si per se consideretur, vt hi- ems est, sed vbi cum æstate confertur, quâ fri- gidior est: & quia inæqualiter temperatus est, vtpote meridie multò calidior quam mane aut vesperi, nec in humido & ficco medium & æqualem statum obtiner, ita vt eodem die mo- dò frigus modò calor vrgeat, propter hanc in- quam, inæqualem temperiem morbiferū eum recte appellatum censendum est: vt ita 4. anni temporum quodlibet ex suapte natura non ex alterius comparatione calidum, humidum, fri- gidum vel siccum æstimandum sit & nomi- nandum. Quod autem Hippocrates ver vocat saluberrimum, ratio est, quod omnium excel- suum medium sit ver, id est, quia æqualitatem quandā tenet caloris, frigoris, humidi & sicci, obidq; morbis mortiferis minimè obnoxius.

page.notes: Catchword "Halle-" read as printed at the foot right; it is not repeated in the text as a paragraph, so the text ends with the last full line. Faint ink specks and stains in the right margin are not text and are omitted. The word "Halle-" was partly obscured; the catchword is read as "Halle-" with some doubt. Possible printing irregularities: "vt" used for "ut" in the printed text is left as printed. Lines "ad eundem" and "ficco" read with confidence; "obidq;" is printed as such.
